feeds.description: The blog posts below were written by Board Members and staff as well as occasional member posts. You will find a mix of homeschooling-related posts that are practical, inspirational, or vision-oriented. Heritage Christian School is a Premier Support Group for Christ-Centered Home Education: Centered on Christ, Driven by Parents, United in Purpose, Motivated by Love.

feeds.title: Community Bible Church Blog
feeds.description: Community Bible Church Blog is the official website of Community Bible Church, a non-denominational Christian church located in San Diego, California. The church was founded in 1978 and has a congregation of over 2,000 people. The church's mission is to 'glorify God by making disciples of Jesus Christ.'

feeds.title: David Jeremiah Blog
feeds.description: Dr. David Jeremiah is the Founder of Turning Point and one of America's most trusted Bible teachers. Their blog covers topics related to Adversity, the Bible, Christian Living, Devotional, Family, Finance, Heaven, Prayer, Prophecy, and Spiritual Warfare.

feeds.title: Newbreak Church Blog
feeds.description: Newbreak Church partners with various organizations to provide under-resourced individuals and communities with access to basic human needs. Every week we send out an email providing helpful links to the week's content, guides for kids and students so they can follow along at home, as well as updated news and information that are important to Newbreak Church as a whole.

feeds.title: San Diego Christian College Blog
feeds.description: San Diego Christian College (formerly Christian Heritage College) was generated through the vision of Drs. Tim and Beverly LaHaye who felt the need for a Christ-centered college on the West Coast. In July 2022, San Diego Christian College relocated to its current campus in the San Diego suburban city of Spring Valley also known as the Mt. Helix Campus. Explore their informative and educational blog and learn more about the college, their courses, their staff and more.
